name: chepauk
tacticalNotes: Spinners are highly effective in the middle overs. Batting first is often preferred.

name: wankhede
tacticalNotes: Pace bowlers get early swing, but it becomes a batting paradise later. Chase is heavily favored due to dew.

name: chinnaswamy
tacticalNotes: Small boundaries make defending very difficult. High-scoring venue.

name: eden gardens
tacticalNotes: Good pace and bounce. Dew factor in second innings makes gripping the ball hard for spinners.

name: narendra modi
tacticalNotes: Red soil pitches offer bounce, black soil is slower. Adapt to the specific strip.
